news_cards.title: Mukhyamantri Ne Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Ka Kiya Shubharambh
bullets: Nishulk steamer ferry seva Nasiriganj-Panapur ke beech shuru ki gayi hai, jisse awagaman aur aarthik gatividhiyon ko badhava milega.
Is seva ke tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas kiya jayega, jisse yatraiyon ko suvidha hogi.
Yeh pariyojna Bihar sarkar ki vikas yojana ke tahat aati hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein aadhunik parivahan vyavastha ko badhava dena hai.

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nasha Mukti Abhiyan Mein MoU
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne nasha mukti abhiyan ke liye Brahmakumari sanstha ke saath MoU kiya hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein nasha mukt yuvapan ka vikas karna hai.
Is abhiyan ke tahat yuvaon ko nasha se mukt karne ke liye vibhinn karyakram aayojit kiye jayenge, jisse unhein samajik aur aarthik roop se samarth banaya ja sake.
Yeh abhiyan Bihar sarkar ki swasthya aur samajik kalayana yojana ke tahat aata hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein swasthya aur samajik suraksha ko badhava dena hai.

news_cards.title: Maa Mundeshwari Boddh Gaya Sulatanganj Aur Mandar Ke Aitihasik Sthalon Ka Vikas
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Maa Mundeshwari, Boddh Gaya, Sulatanganj aur Mandar ke aitihasik sthalon ka vikas karne ka nirdesh diya hai, jisse ve vishwa star par paryatan kendra ban sakein.
Is pariyojna ke tahat in sthalon ka vaigyanik sarvekshan kiya jayega, jisse unke aitihasik mahatva ko sanrakshit kiya ja sake.
Yeh pariyojna Bihar sarkar ki paryatan vikas yojana ke tahat aati hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein paryatan ko badhava dena hai.
